title: Account cells v55
notes: Replaces the links text box with a list of link rows: a large Add link button, and per-link account cells (All accounts by default; choosing an account adds one more optional cell for the next account). Pasting several links splits them into separate rows, a Sale price field appears only in Sale mode and a link can be deleted with its X button. Also includes the Japanese store support (/jp/ja/wishlist) and per-link account scanning from v53, and a What's new window that is shown once per version and describes only the current version. Keeps all v52 activity profile, per-account card, live status/journal, Acrylic, account, exact-variant URL, LAN and launcher improvements. Verified with 45 backend/API/account tests, a clean WinUI Release build with zero warnings/errors and a published single-exe launcher run (runtime and backend extracted, application stayed running).

title: Japan store and account links v53
notes: Adds Japanese store support: /jp/ja/wishlist links are accepted and the Japanese add-to-cart and out-of-stock buttons plus the IN_STOCK/STOCK_OUT API statuses are recognised, so in-stock Japanese wishlist items are detected. Adds per-link account binding: write 'link @ Account 1, Account 2' (account name, id or number) in the links box and only those accounts scan that link; links without '@' are still scanned by all accounts, and a link bound to an unknown account is reported in the journal instead of being silently skipped. Keeps all v52 activity profile, per-account card, live status/journal, Acrylic, account, exact-variant URL, LAN and launcher improvements. Verified with 45 backend/API/account tests, an embedded JavaScript syntax check, a clean WinUI Release build with zero warnings/errors and a published single-exe launcher smoke test (runtime and backend extracted, application stayed running).

title: Activity profile v52
notes: Adds a persistent Profile footer page with a 365-day activity calendar, daily scan/find totals, yearly totals and daily records. Activity shades follow the selected accent and support light/dark themes. History is stored locally, counts backend resets correctly and flushes synchronously during shutdown. Keeps all v51 per-account card, live status/journal, Acrylic, account, exact-variant URL, LAN and launcher improvements. Verified with 26 backend/API/account tests in three full runs, three signed LAN tests, a dedicated persistence/reset/flush test, five footer-navigation runs, five published-runtime runs, three isolated launcher runs and clean WinUI Release builds with zero warnings/errors.

title: Live account status and Acrylic v51
notes: Fixes the multi-account card metric so it reports the current pass and can decrease after switching from a large wishlist to a smaller one. Adds the current account and translated action under Monitor plus a bounded live journal at the bottom of Home. Replaces whole-interface fading with real Desktop Acrylic transparency on Windows 10 and 11, keeping text and controls fully opaque, and applies the selected accent colour to primary buttons, toggles, sliders, progress, navigation selection, charts and text selection. Includes the complete v50 guide and all account, exact-variant URL, LAN and launcher fixes. Verified with 26 backend/API/account tests in three full runs, three signed LAN policy-sync tests, five published-runtime navigation runs, three isolated launcher runs and a clean WinUI Release build with zero warnings/errors. The local saved UNIQLO session on the build PC returned HTTP 401 No access token and was not modified; users with that status must reopen the account and save fresh cookies.

title: Personalization fix and complete guide v50
notes: Fixes the confirmed WinUI crash when opening Personalization: the opacity slider minimum is now assigned only after its maximum is initialized, and dynamic sidebar rebuilding is guarded against re-entrant navigation. Replaces the small About page with a 13-section Russian guide covering quick start, accounts and cookies, normal/API/Sale/Amazon/Zara modes, workers and full-scan pauses, exact variant URLs, private-LAN device policies, market prices, versions, personalization, security and extensive troubleshooting. Keeps all v49 interface, chart, account, LAN, launcher and scrolling improvements. Verified with 24 backend/API/account tests in three full runs, three signed LAN policy-sync tests, five complete page-navigation runs, five published-runtime personalization/About runs, three isolated first-launch extraction runs, and a clean WinUI Release build with zero warnings/errors.

title: Interface and shared device control v49
notes: Redesigned Windows 10/11 interface with a clean dashboard and separate Accounts, Modes and workers, LAN, Versions and Personalization pages. Adds account rename and managed Chromium opening with saved cookies; stable one-second charts with a fixed 90-second window and 60-second smoothing; synchronized per-device sound and product-opening policies across the private LAN; automatic private-firewall repair and Start menu shortcut; adjustable opacity, window size, navigation headings/order and ten accent colours; direct 120-4200 px/s Chrome scrolling without the former 1800 px/s floor. Keeps exact priceGroup URLs, multi-account API rotation and the relocated AppData launcher fix. Verified with 24 tests in three full runs, three signed LAN policy-sync tests, backend utility smoke, real junction extraction, UI process smoke and clean WinUI builds with zero warnings/errors.

title: Relocated AppData launcher fix v48
notes: Fixes Errno 17 / WinError 183 during first-run extraction when FastWorkSingle or AppData is relocated to another drive through a Windows junction. The launcher now resolves the physical directory before creating its unique staging folder. Keeps the v47 priceGroup URL correction and all multi-account/LAN features. Verified with 23 tests in three full runs, a real junction extraction probe on the affected machine, three LAN self-tests and a clean WinUI Release build.

title: Price group path v47
notes: Fixes UNIQLO API links whose colour, size and price were correct but whose PDP path still belonged to a different price group. FastWork now reads priceGroup and rewrites /00, /01 or /02 accordingly. E479755 RED 17 size 005 at GBP 9.90 now opens /02 instead of the expensive /00 colour 09 page. Keeps v46 account deletion, v45 exact wishlist URLs and v44 signed LAN routing. Verified with 22 tests in three full runs, three live official-page checks, three LAN self-tests and a clean WinUI Release build.

title: Account deletion v46
notes: Adds a confirmed Delete button next to the UNIQLO account selector. Removing a profile deletes its saved cookies and isolated Chrome login data, while the last remaining account is protected from deletion. Keeps v45 exact wishlist variant matching and v44 signed LAN routing. Verified with 21 tests in three full runs, three LAN self-tests, and a clean WinUI Release build.

title: Wishlist URL priority v45
notes: Fixes conflicting UNIQLO variant metadata in API mode. The exact saved wishlist URL is now authoritative: /01?colorDisplayCode=69&sizeDisplayCode=006 remains /01/69/006 even when sibling API fields describe the default /00 colour 08 product. Ranked URL selection prefers explicit colour/size links, preserves the original path, and rejects the neighbouring expensive variant. Keeps v44 signed LAN routing and concurrent-launch extraction fixes.

title: Exact variant and LAN routing v44
notes: Preserves the exact UNIQLO API variant URL through result storage and opening, including colorDisplayCode and sizeDisplayCode, so a discounted Red variant cannot fall back to the default Blue product. Adds signed same-LAN discovery and link routing: each FastWork computer can open locally and select any discovered peers as additional recipients. Also fixes concurrent first-run extraction with a per-version lock and unique staging folders.

title: API full-scan pause v43
notes: Corrects v42 API pacing: all pages of a complete wishlist are collected immediately with up to five concurrent pagination requests, then the monitor waits max(configured account pause, 20 seconds) before the next account or repeat. Verified twice against an authenticated 999-item wishlist: 11.74s and 7.94s collections with exactly 20.0s between completed passes.

title: Multi-account API safety v42
notes: Superseded by v43 because this version pauses between pagination requests. Use v43, which applies the 20-second minimum only after a complete wishlist has been collected.

title: Regional API client ID v41
notes: Fixes API mode HTTP 400 invalid or missing client id on regional storefront paths such as eu-pl. The scanner now discovers and caches the exact regional client ID published by the current UNIQLO JavaScript bundle for both direct HTTP and browser API scans.

title: API client sync v40
notes: Fixes API mode by discovering and caching the current UNIQLO storefront build version instead of sending an outdated hard-coded client version. Both direct HTTP and browser API scans now stay synchronized with the official site.

title: Zara card discovery v39
notes: Fixes Zara card discovery: the scan now recognizes current card markup through product links and add actions, waits longer for the page, and ignores temporary zero-size button geometry.

title: Zara wishlist v38
notes: Adds Zara wishlist monitoring with one visible worker, a 10-second global reload guard, Polish stock-button detection, full-page bottom verification, and login/anti-bot cooldowns.

title: API mode toggle v37
notes: API mode checkbox now activates correctly by disabling incompatible Chrome, Sale, and Amazon options instead of being reset. API remains limited to one worker.

title: API mode jump scroll v36
notes: API mode is restored with a hard 1-worker limit and sequential direct wishlist API reads. Boosts are removed. Normal mode is capped at 10 workers, Sale at 3, Amazon at 1. Old Max mode is replaced by Jump scroll.

title: Wishlist fast start v35
notes: Wishlist scans now start scrolling immediately after the page opens. The pre-scroll wishlist API wait is skipped by default, so ADD TO CART/BAG DOM hits are handled without the startup delay.

title: Wishlist DOM trust v34
notes: Wishlist DOM hits now bypass the API alias filter, so visible ADD TO CART/BAG cards on the wishlist page are reported by product href even when the API variant key differs. Wishlist-only configs are forced to one worker.

title: Wishlist card link v33
notes: Wishlist DOM detection now treats visible ADD TO CART/BAG buttons inside product cards as availability, extracts the product link from a.fr-ec-product-tile, and never clicks the add-to-cart button.

title: Wishlist stock reload language v32
notes: Wishlist reloads when UNIQLO shows Failed to get items, stock detection is stricter (ADD TO CART/BAG vs NOTIFY ME), and wishlist URLs are accepted only when the language segment is en.

title: Wishlist empty recovery v31
notes: Wishlist now detects an empty viewport after a network stall, stops treating empty scrollY movement as useful progress, and performs a deeper up-scroll recovery before continuing the fast scan.

title: Wishlist fast scroll v30
notes: Wishlist scrolling is much faster: default speed is raised to 2200 px/s, chunks are longer to reduce Python/JS overhead, and old configs are migrated. Up-scroll recovery still runs only after a real stall.

title: What's new v29
notes: The in-app What's New screen now describes the current wishlist lazy-load behavior: recovery scrolls up only after a real stall, while normal forward scrolling is treated as progress.

title: Wishlist forward progress v28
notes: Wishlist up-scroll recovery now runs only when loading is truly stuck: no new cards/height and no forward scroll progress. Normal downward scrolling no longer triggers recovery just because visible card count is stable.

title: Wishlist stuck recovery v27
notes: Wishlist scrolling no longer reloads at partial counts like 233/999. Up-scroll recovery now runs only after loading stalls, uses a stronger upward nudge, extends timeout for large wishlists, forces wishlist to one worker, and save-wishlist reports login state clearly.

title: Wishlist progress stable v25
notes: Wishlist progress is now based on loaded cards versus the page total, worker rows update without flicker, short pause no longer resets progress, and 100% is shown only after the target count is reached.

title: Wishlist live card count v24
notes: Wishlist live-scroll now reports loaded DOM cards separately from API total, adds a per-worker scroll progress bar, and no longer shows a 999 wishlist target as already scanned before the page reaches the bottom.

title: Wishlist live scroll v23
notes: Wishlist now uses browser live-scroll by default instead of API-only waves. It reacts to in-stock wishlist cards as soon as they load during scrolling, keeps scrolling after a hit, and no longer emits API-only products as a batch at the end.

title: Wishlist live chunks v22
notes: Fixes the real reason wishlist browser results were emitted in a batch at the bottom: the scroll JavaScript had a hidden 15-second minimum chunk. Browser scroll now yields back to Python in short live chunks, checks the first screen immediately, and keeps the strict product/color/size filtering from V21.

title: Wishlist DOM strict v21
notes: Fixes wishlist browser-mode false positives: visible DOM Add to cart cards are now filtered by the exact wishlist product/color/size from the API, so a saved color no longer opens a neighboring /00 variant. Finds can be emitted during scrolling from the early API read instead of waiting for the bottom. Keeps the V20 version-manager fallback.

title: Version manager fallback v20
notes: Fixes the version manager: old versions are visible again from the local FastWorkSingle runtime cache, GitHub API has raw-manifest fallback, and settings now show a useful load status instead of silently leaving only the current version.

title: Wishlist live URL v19
notes: Wishlist fix: exact saved product URL is preserved, so /01 links no longer turn into /00 variants. Browser wishlist scan now shows found items while scrolling instead of waiting for the very bottom. Added a first-launch update card with a short animated presentation and human-readable changes.

title: Wishlist API strict v18
notes: Fixes wishlist API strict variant filtering so same-name different-price variants are not reported; API waves now continue past the first page when total is missing.
